PinCard.Name: Pin / close quickslot info card
PinCard.Hint: Press while an info card is showing to pin it, so you can scroll it with the mouse and click its links. Press again or Esc to close.

Keys.TogglePortraits: Hide/show party portraits on my screen

Notify.NotPf2e: Not the PF2e system, so the module stays off.

SettingsWindow.Title: Rutz's PF2e HUD Settings
SettingsWindow.Empty: Nothing here that you can change.

browserHideLegacy.Name: Compendium Browser: Hide legacy
browserHideLegacy.Hint: Leaves pre-remaster (legacy) entries out of the PF2e Compendium Browser (feats, spells, equipment …). Reopen the browser or reload after changing this.

chatFaceZoom.Name: Tidy chat portraits (round tokens for NPCs)
chatFaceZoom.Hint: NPCs: tokens that use a token ring (e.g. NPCs from art modules) are redrawn as a round token with the subject inside the ring, like on the map, so they don't spill over the top of the chat card. PCs: PF2e's own picture is left as it is.

bulkDamage.Name: Damage card: “Apply all” button (PF2e Toolbelt)
bulkDamage.Hint: On damage cards with Toolbelt's target rows, adds a button that applies everyone's damage at once by their save result (critical failure ×2 · failure ×1 · success ×½ · critical success none). GM only.

chatTrim.Name: Trim chat cards (less lag in long sessions)
chatTrim.Hint: Keeps only the latest cards on the page and takes older ones out of it (the messages themselves stay). Scrolling up brings them back. Does the same job as the Less Chat module, so turn on only one of the two.

chatTrimKeep.Name: Chat cards kept on the page

chatJumpButton.Name: ↓ button to the latest message
chatJumpButton.Hint: Shows a small button in the corner of the chat while you are scrolled up.

sustainChecker.Name: Sustain reminder
sustainChecker.Hint: Casting a Sustain spell puts a “Sustain: spell” effect on the caster. When that character's turn starts, the player and the GM get a whispered card asking “Sustain (1 action) / End”. Choosing End also removes the effects the spell put on anyone. Replaces pf2e-sustain-reminder.

hudEnabled.Name: Show character HUD
hudEnabled.Hint: Keeps the quickslot HUD of the token you last selected at the bottom of the screen.

hudScale.Name: HUD size
hudScale.Hint: Overall HUD scale. Slot size follows the screen width automatically and is then multiplied by this.

hudEffectSize.Name: Condition/effect icon size (px)
hudEffectSize.Hint: Diameter of the round condition and effect icons above the HP bar.

hudEffectDurations.Name: Show effect time left
hudEffectDurations.Hint: Draws a ring around effect icons for the time left and adds a short label (3R · 7m · 1h). Hover for the exact time left, the total and when it ends.

hudReactionPip.Name: Show reaction next to the action pips
hudReactionPip.Hint: In combat, shows a reaction (↩) pip next to the action pips. It fills in when you choose “Use” on a reaction prompt, and you can also click/right-click it yourself. It comes back when your turn starts.

hudSaveCard.Name: Post a DC card with saving throws
hudSaveCard.Hint: Clicking Fortitude, Reflex or Will on the HUD also posts a “Fortitude DC 26” (10 + modifier) card to chat along with the roll.

hudHideCoreHotbar.Name: Hide Foundry's macro bar
hudHideCoreHotbar.Hint: Use only the module's quickslots. The number keys then work only on the quickslots too.

hudHideEffectsPanel.Name: Hide PF2e's effects panel
hudHideEffectsPanel.Hint: Hides PF2e's column of effect icons at the top right. Effects are shown above the HUD's HP bar instead.

hudAutoInfused.Name: Auto-place infused items
hudAutoInfused.Hint: Puts infused items (made by an alchemist and the like) into empty quickslots automatically, and clears them away when they're gone.

hudNpcAutoFill.Name: Auto-fill NPC quickslots
hudNpcAutoFill.Hint: The first time the GM selects an NPC whose quickslots are empty, they're filled with Strikes → actions → spells.

hudSlotCard.Name: Quickslot Info Card
hudSlotCard.Hint: Rest the mouse on a quickslot for a moment to see its cost, traits and description on a card — no need to open the sheet.

hudSlotCardDelay.Name: Quickslot Info Card: Delay (seconds)
hudSlotCardDelay.Hint: How long the mouse has to rest before the card appears. Shorter is quicker, but the card then also pops up when you just pass over a slot.

chatDock.Name: Chat clock and dice
chatDock.Hint: Shows the date and time at the top of the chat, and dice and flat check (5 · 11) buttons above the input box.

clock12h.Name: Chat clock: 12-hour (AM/PM)
clock12h.Hint: When off, the clock uses 24-hour time (15:05).

timeDarknessSync.Name: Match scene lighting to the time
timeDarknessSync.Hint: When game time changes, sets the current scene's darkness for day, dawn, dusk or night (can be turned off per scene). If PF2e's world clock sync is on, that takes priority.

paletteOpacity.Name: GM palette opacity
paletteOpacity.Hint: Becomes opaque when you hover over it.

healthOnHover.Name: Show health status on token hover
healthOnHover.Hint: For tokens whose HP you can't see (usually NPCs), shows only a rough status such as “Lightly hurt”.

healthShowGM.Name: Show health status to the GM too

tokenTipDistance.Name: Show distance on token hover
tokenTipDistance.Hint: Shows the distance from your selected token (or else your character) to that token, stacked above the health status. While on, PF2e's own distance label is hidden so the two don't overlap. With “Never”, PF2e's own label is used as usual.

healthFullShow.Name: Show “Unharmed”
healthFullShow.Hint: Full HP is the most common state, so by default it's hidden and shown only in encounters.

healthLevels.Name: Health status levels
healthLevels.Hint: “percent:name” pairs separated by |. At or above that percent, that name is shown. E.g. 75:Lightly hurt|50:Hurt|25:Badly hurt|1:Near death. Left at the default, the built-in labels follow your language.

reactionChecker.Name: Reaction alerts
reactionChecker.Hint: When a reaction can be used (an enemy moves, attacks, deals damage …), only that character's player and the GM are told, with a chat card. (No pf2e-reaction or socketlib needed.)

reactionPopup.Name: Reaction alert pop-up
reactionPopup.Hint: Along with the chat card, shows a small prompt at the top of the screen (gone after 30 seconds).

reactionPopupGM.Name: Reaction pop-up for the GM too
reactionPopupGM.Hint: When off, the GM gets chat cards only (handy when NPCs have lots of reactions).

turnTracker.Name: Turn Tracker (top of screen)
turnTracker.Hint: A light tracker at the top of the screen that shows only the turn order, round and initiative during combat. Not shown while Carousel Combat Tracker is active.

turnTrackerDefeated.Name: Turn Tracker: Defeated combatants
turnTrackerDefeated.Hint: Whether dead or defeated combatants are hidden or kept in grey. They're never hidden during their own turn. Combatants at 0 HP who aren't dead (dying, unconscious) are always shown half grey, and go back to normal when healed.

turnTrackerWidth.Name: Turn Tracker: Portrait width (px)
turnTrackerWidth.Hint: The portrait of whoever is acting shows 1.2× larger. Portraits never shrink in big fights; the overflow is folded into “+n”.

turnTrackerGroup.Name: Turn Tracker: Group identical enemies
turnTrackerGroup.Hint: Folds enemies of the same kind (same name and picture) whose turns come one after another into one portrait marked ×n. The current and the next turn are never folded.

turnSkipDead.Name: Turn Tracker: Skip defeated enemies' turns
turnSkipDead.Hint: When the turn of an enemy at 0 HP or dead comes up (player characters excluded), the GM's client passes it on once automatically. This stops a double click on Next, after the turn landed on a dead enemy, from skipping the first character.

turnTrackerTop.Name: Turn Tracker: Distance from the top (px)
turnTrackerTop.Hint: Increase this if it overlaps the scene navigation bar or the like.

playersListMode.Name: Players list
playersListMode.Hint: If the players list at the bottom left covers the portraits, fold it into a small icon. Click the icon to peek at the list.

portraitSlotsMenu.Name: Portrait Manager
portraitSlotsMenu.Label: Open portrait manager
portraitSlotsMenu.Hint: Assigns characters to seats PC 1–6. Empty seats are filled with the players' assigned characters automatically.

portraitsShown.Name: Show party portraits (everyone)
portraitsShown.Hint: When the GM turns this on, the party portraits appear on everyone's screen.

portraitsHideLocal.Name: Hide portraits on my screen only
portraitsHideLocal.Hint: Hides them on this computer even when the GM has them on.

portraitStyleDefault.Name: Portrait style (world default)
portraitStyleDefault.Hint: Everyone's default style, set by the GM. Players can pick their own under “Portrait style (my screen)” below.

portraitStyle.Name: Portrait style (my screen)
portraitStyle.Hint: “Card” puts the portrait on a translucent panel. “Image only” drops the panel and frame so only the character art shows. Recommended art: square 512×512 px (at least 256×256; 768×768 on a 4K screen). Card: keep the face in the top third — the top and bottom may be cropped. Image only: a PNG/WebP with a transparent background, with the figure's waist or feet touching the bottom edge. Tall full-body art (e.g. 400×800) shows small, so pad it out to a square.

portraitIdleDim.Name: Dim idle portraits
portraitIdleDim.Hint: Greys portraits out slightly while they aren't talking or chatting.

portraitScale.Name: Portrait size
portraitScale.Hint: The largest size. On a short screen they shrink automatically so they don't overlap.

portraitBottomMargin.Name: Portrait bottom margin (px)
portraitBottomMargin.Hint: How far above the bottom of the screen the lowest row (PC 5 · 6) sits. Increase it if a voice app or the bottom UI covers them.

portraitImage.Name: Portrait image source
portraitImage.Hint: Token art (including dynamic token rings) can look small in a portrait because of its round frame. If you can, give the actor portrait a square 512×512 image.

portraitHpNumbers.Name: Portrait HP numbers
portraitHpNumbers.Hint: The HP bar is always shown. Choose who sees the numbers.

portraitChatBubbles.Name: Chat speech bubbles
portraitChatBubbles.Hint: When a character chats, their portrait lights up with a speech bubble beside it. (Rolls and cards only light it up briefly, without a bubble.)

whisperPolicy.Name: Whisper scope
whisperPolicy.Hint: Who players can whisper, and whether the GM sees whispers between players. Applies the same way to whispers typed with “/w”.

Choices.allGmSees: Players too — the GM always sees them

chatGrouping.Name: Group chat messages
chatGrouping.Hint: Merges consecutive lines from the same speaker into one block.

chatGroupWindow.Name: Grouping window (minutes)
chatGroupWindow.Hint: Only lines from the same speaker that follow within this time are merged.

chatShowUser.Name: Show the player's name
chatShowUser.Hint: Shows the real player's name in small type under the character's name.

chatAvatars.Name: Show chat portraits
chatAvatars.Hint: Shows the speaker's token/character image on the left of the chat card.

chatCardTheme.Name: Chat card tone
chatCardTheme.Hint: Light cards look like the attached example. Dark cards are closer to Foundry's default theme.

chatHeadingFont.Name: Name / check line font
chatHeadingFont.Hint: Font used for character names and check description lines.

chatBodyFont.Name: Chat font
chatBodyFont.Hint: Applies to chat message text only. Sheets, windows and card titles stay as they are. “Default” follows the PF2e-KR font.

chatFontFamily.Name: Custom chat font (advanced)
chatFontFamily.Hint: Leave empty to use the font chosen above. Enter a CSS font-family value as is.

chatFontSize.Name: Chat font size (px)
chatFontSize.Hint: 0 = default size. Applies to chat message text only.

chatSidebarWidth.Name: Chat sidebar width (px)
chatSidebarWidth.Hint: 0 = Foundry's default. Foundry's sidebar width changes with the font size setting, so use this to fix it. (Recommended 340–420)

chatHideEditorMenu.Name: Hide the chat input's formatting toolbar
chatHideEditorMenu.Hint: Hides the “Paragraph · Italic · HTML” toolbar above the chat input in Foundry v13/v14. Shortcuts such as Ctrl+B and Ctrl+I still work. The space goes to the speaking-character bar (Rutz's Cinematic Stage).

typingIndicator.Name: Typing indicator
typingIndicator.Hint: While someone types in the chat box, shows “… is typing” above the input. Not shown while a whisper (/w) is being written. Replaces the same feature of Cautious Gamemaster's Pack.

typingShowKeeper.Name: Show the GM's typing too
typingShowKeeper.Hint: Shows players “typing” while the GM writes as well. When off, the GM's typing isn't shown.

typingReserveHeight.Name: Typing line height (px)
typingReserveHeight.Hint: Height of the line where “… is typing” appears. The space is always kept free, so the chat cards don't move when the indicator comes and goes. 0 hides the indicator.

typingSelector.Name: Typing indicator selector (advanced)
typingSelector.Hint: CSS selector of other typing indicators to move into the reserved strip. Leave empty to move nothing.

voiceBridgeEnabled.Name: Use the Discord voice link
voiceBridgeEnabled.Hint: When off, nothing connects to the bridge and no connection errors are logged. Tables that don't use Discord should leave it off. Connecting from the setup wizard turns it on automatically.

voiceBridgeUrl.Name: Discord voice bridge address
voiceBridgeUrl.Hint: The bridge bot's address. Only one GM connects and relays to everyone, so players never need to reach this address. The setup wizard fills it in for you.

voiceBridgeMenu.Name: Discord ↔ Foundry users
voiceBridgeMenu.Label: Manage links
voiceBridgeMenu.Hint: Links Discord users to Foundry users one by one. The connection status and recent voice signals are shown here too.

voiceSetupMenu.Name: Discord voice setup wizard
voiceSetupMenu.Label: Open setup wizard
voiceSetupMenu.Hint: Guides you step by step through installing the voice bridge on a local PC or an Oracle server. Hardly any commands to type yourself.

Lore.NoCheck: Couldn't find this character's Lore check. Check the Lore entries on the sheet.
Lore.RollFailed: The Lore roll failed. Check it on the sheet.

Chat.SafeMode: Safe mode: all chat DOM changes are off.
Chat.TestResult: If “Test is typing…” shows above the chat input for 4 seconds, the display side works.

Sustain.EffectDesc: Sustained spell: {spell}. You're asked whether to Sustain it when your turn starts.

Skills.Title: Skills
Skills.FollowOff: Exploration activity: click to turn the effect on
Skills.NoFollowEffect: Couldn't find the “Follow the Expert” effect.

Expiry.RoundEnd: ends at the end of the round

Pin.On: Pinned — stays on this character when you select other tokens (click to unpin)
Pin.Off: Pin this character (stays when you select other tokens)

Hud.SaveCardTip: Also posts a {save} DC {dc} card to chat
Hud.DcTip: Post a saving throw request to chat
Hud.DcTipDetail: With Fortitude · Reflex · Will DC {dc} buttons

Bar.Skills: Skills — every skill and skill action
Bar.SkillsHelp: Click to roll · Hover for details

Pop.ItemHelp: Click: post to chat · Right-click: details
Pop.InventoryHint: Drag onto a quickslot to place it
Pop.GrimoireHint: For “oh right, I have that too” — click to post to chat

Notify.NoEdit: You don't have permission to change this character's quickslot layout.
Notify.Locked: The quickslots are locked. Click the lock on the left to unlock them, then edit.

Use.DetailsTip: Opens this item's sheet for the full description

Spell.PreparedUsed: Everything prepared at this rank is already cast
Spell.NoSlotsRank: No slots left at this rank

Tip.Innate: Innate spell — uses one of today's uses
Tip.Slot: Spends a spell slot of this rank

Spell.ChatTip: Posts only the spell card, without spending a slot or Focus Point
Spell.DetailsTip: Opens this spell's sheet for the full description
Spell.Ritual: Cast rituals from the Spells tab of the character sheet

Card.Pinned: Pinned · Scroll with the wheel · Esc to close
Card.StrikeHelp: Click: choose which attack · Middle-click: third attack

Help.Consumable: Click: post the card · Shift+click: use
Help.Effect: Click: toggle on the selected tokens

Slots.CantStrikeWhy: {name}: can't Strike right now (not held, or none left).
Slots.OwnItemsOnly: Only items this character has can go on a slot.
Slots.CantDrop: This can't go on a slot. Right-click an empty slot and pick from the list instead.

Picker.Hint: Drag items, spells, feats and macros onto a slot from the sheet or the macro directory.
Picker.Title: Add to slot — {name}

Editors.Title: Quickslot edit permissions — {name}
Editors.Hint: Even with ownership, only the people checked here (and the GM) can rearrange the slots. Every owner can use them.

Clock.SyncScene: Match this scene's lighting to the time
Clock.Pf2eSyncs: PF2e's world clock has “Sync scene darkness” on, so it sets the lighting.

Request.Title: Roll Request
Request.PickLore: Choose a Lore from the sheets…
Request.RowDcTip: DC for this roll only (empty = the default DC below)
Request.PickHint: Pick rolls above. You can pick several.
Request.LoreHint: Choose one from the sheets or type a name, then press ‘Add’ and ‘Send’.
Request.NeedLore: Choose a Lore or type its name.
Request.MacroMadePlaced: Created macro "{name}" — added to the GM palette.

Palette.Title: GM Palette
Palette.Locked: Locked — click to edit (move · add · remove)
Palette.Editing: Editing — drag to move, drop to add, right-click to remove
Palette.OnlyTypes: Only macros, effects and conditions can go here.

Trigger.manipulate: An enemy within reach makes a ranged attack, uses a manipulate action or casts a spell
Trigger.critFail: An enemy critically fails an attack against me
Trigger.allyDamaged: An ally in range takes damage

Reactions.NoMelee: No melee weapon to Strike with as a reaction.
Reactions.StrikeQuestion: Which weapon do you Strike with?
Reactions.SbReverted: {name}: damage reverted. Turn the shield on in the original damage card and apply it again.
Reactions.SbNote: {name} Shield Block — damage reverted. Turn on the shield (block) toggle and apply it again.
Reactions.NoPermission: You don't have permission to change this character's reaction settings.

Config.Title: Reaction Settings — {name}
Config.WhoHint: If nobody is picked, only the player assigned this character and the GM are asked (not people who merely own it).
Config.PerHint: Recognized reactions come with their default conditions filled in. Ctrl+click to pick several triggers.

Turns.MoreHelp: Click: show everyone (scroll with the wheel)
Turns.GroupHelp: Each click moves to the next one
Turns.EndHelp: Click: end turn · Shift+click: look at the token

Manager.SeatsHint: Left empty, the players' assigned characters take the seats in user-list order.

Portraits.EditTag: Drag to move · Wheel to resize
Portraits.Editing: Portrait layout editing: drag to move, wheel to resize. The same button locks it again.
Portraits.Reset: Portraits are back in their default positions.

Faces.NoPicker: You can't open the file picker. Paste the image path instead.
Faces.NoActor: Select the character to set expressions for first.
Faces.NoPermission: You don't have permission to change this character's expressions or token images.
Faces.Title: Expressions · Token Images — {name}
Faces.Hint1: Put @keyword in a chat message and the portrait switches to that expression. The keyword is removed from the message.
Faces.Hint2: @{face} goes back to the normal portrait. Sending only a keyword changes the expression without posting a message.
Faces.PresetsHint: Switch them from the {icon} button on the token's right-click HUD. “Original image” is always offered as well.

Whisper.Title: Whispers
Whisper.PickHint: Pick someone's tab to whisper them right away.

Notes.Title: Notes (shared)
Notes.None: Nothing written yet. Type below and press Enter.
Notes.Placeholder: A notebook everyone shares. Enter to post, Shift+Enter for a new line. Right-click your own entries to edit or delete them.
Notes.NotYours: Only the GM can edit other people's entries.
Notes.NoJournal: You don't have permission to create journal entries.

Mapping.Title: Discord Voice Links
Mapping.Empty: No users linked yet. Add one with the button below.
Mapping.HeardHint: With the bridge connected, speak in the voice channel. The Discord IDs heard show up here; press + to add a row right away. No need to look IDs up yourself.
Mapping.NotIn: Not in any voice channel right now.
Mapping.LeaveHint: Between sessions, press Leave. The bot drops out of the voice channel and goes back to it when you press the button again. No need to restart anything on the server.
Mapping.ChannelsLater: Once connected, the voice channels the bot can see are listed here.
Mapping.BadId: A Discord ID is a 15–21 digit number: {ids}
Mapping.DupId: The same Discord ID is listed twice: {ids}
Mapping.SavedPartial: Users saved: {n}. Rows left out because of empty fields: {skipped}.
Mapping.Adopt: Add a row for this ID

Setup.CopyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
Setup.Title: Discord Voice Setup Wizard
Setup.ResetTip: Clears every answer and the connection settings and starts over
Setup.LocalDesc: You run Foundry on Windows and the players connect to it. You only double-click one file (.bat).
Setup.Server: On a server such as Oracle (pm2 + Caddy)
Setup.ServerDesc: Paste into SSH once and add a few lines to your Caddy config. It starts again by itself after the server reboots.
Setup.EitherWay: Either way, only one GM's screen receives the voice signals and passes them on to every player. Players don't need to set anything up.
Setup.RemoveSummary: To remove a bridge you installed on a server and start again
Setup.RemoveHint: Run the line below over SSH to remove the pm2 entry and the settings file (.env).
Setup.Guide2: Bot menu → Reset Token → paste the token below.
Setup.Guide3: In OAuth2 → URL Generator, pick the scope bot and the permissions View Channels · Connect, then invite the bot to your server with the generated URL.
Setup.Guide4: Turn on Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click the server and the voice channel and choose Copy ID.
Setup.TokenHint: The token is only used to build the files in the next step and is never saved in the world, because world settings are sent to every player.
Setup.SavedDialog: Saved {name}. If you saved it inside the module folder, double-click that file.
Setup.SavedFallback1: This browser can't open a window to choose where to save, so the file went to your Downloads folder. Move it from Downloads into the module folder (the path above), then run it.
Setup.SavedFallback2: Find it with File Explorer (Win+E) → Downloads, or with Ctrl+J in the browser.
Setup.SavedFallback3: (Browsers block the save window when you connect through http://IP address. It does appear on an https address or on localhost.)
Setup.LocalGuide1: Use the button below to save start-voice-bridge.bat inside the module folder.
Setup.LocalGuide2: Double-click it. The first run takes 1–2 minutes to install the required files.
Setup.LocalGuide3: When the black window shows Joined voice channel, it worked. Keep that window open during the session.
Setup.SaveDirHint: The button opens a window to choose where to save. Paste the path below into the address bar at the top of that window and press Enter to jump straight to that folder. (If you moved your Foundry data folder, go to {path} inside it.)
Setup.AutoStartSummary: To start it automatically whenever Windows starts
Setup.AutoStart2: Copy the saved start-voice-bridge.bat into the Startup folder that opens.
Setup.AutoStart3: To stop, delete the file from that folder.
Setup.LocalNote1: If Node.js is missing, its download page opens automatically. Install the LTS version, then run the file again.
Setup.LocalNote2: This file contains the bot token. Don't send it to anyone.
Setup.NodeSummary: First: does the server have Node.js and pm2?
Setup.NodeHint: Type node -v over SSH; if it shows v20 or later, skip this. Otherwise run the two lines below in order.
Setup.NodeModulesHint: Don't copy the node_modules folder from your PC to the server. Its files are built per operating system, so what was installed on Windows won't run on a Linux server. Step 3 below installs fresh ones for the server.
Setup.DomainHint: Filled in from the address you're using right now. Leave it if it's the domain you use to reach Foundry.
Setup.DataPath: Foundry data folder (on the server; leave it if unsure)
Setup.SshTitle: ① Run over SSH, one line at a time
Setup.SshHint: Copy and paste them one at a time from the top, pressing Enter each time. Go on to the next line once the previous one has finished.
Setup.CaddyTitle: ② Add to the Caddy config
Setup.CaddyHint: Open it with sudo nano /etc/caddy/Caddyfile, change the existing block as below, then run sudo systemctl reload caddy. Caddy handles the certificate and the WebSocket, so port 8787 doesn't need to be opened.
Setup.UpdateHint: Updating the module can remove the .env and the installed files in this folder. If it won't connect after an update, run steps 1–4 of this page again.

State.retrying: Waiting for the bridge… (check that the bridge is running)
State.disabled: The voice link is off — the button above turns it on and connects
State.gaveup: Couldn't find the bridge, so retrying stopped — start the bridge, then press the button above

Setup.LinkHint: Once connected, open the link manager and have everyone speak in the voice channel one at a time. Press + next to each Discord ID heard and pick the Foundry user — that's it.
Setup.HowToLocal: Double-click the start-voice-bridge.bat you saved in step 3. No commands to type. A minimized window appears in the taskbar, and shortly afterwards the status above changes to Connected. This screen updates by itself.
Setup.HowToLocalWhy: For security, a web page (Foundry) can't run programs on your PC, so this one double-click is up to you.
Setup.HowToServerTitle: On a server it should already be running
Setup.HowToServer: If you ran the commands in step 3, pm2 keeps the bridge running and starts it again after a reboot. Nothing to start by hand.
Setup.HowToServerTrouble: If it won't connect: check the bot log over SSH with {logs}, and if you changed the Caddy config, make sure you ran sudo systemctl reload caddy.
Setup.ResetConfirm1: This clears everything entered in the wizard, the bridge address and the connection key, and turns the voice link off.
Setup.ResetConfirm2: The Discord ↔ Foundry user links are kept. To remove a bridge installed on a server as well, follow the note on the first screen.
Setup.ResetDone: Voice link settings have been reset.
Setup.Danger1: Danger: anyone on the internet can read the .env file that holds the bot token.
Setup.Danger2: This server serves files that start with a dot over the web. Reset the token in the Discord Developer Portal right away (Reset Token), and stop this file from being served in your hosting settings.
Setup.Safe: Security check: the settings file (.env) can't be read from the internet.

Cd.Label: Go to the module folder
Cd.Hint: Finds the bridge folder and moves into it. If the last line shows the folder path, it worked.

Env.Label: Create the settings file (.env)
Env.Hint: This line contains the bot token. Careful if you're sharing your screen.

Install.Label: Install the required files
Install.Hint: Downloads fresh files built for this server. This can take 1–2 minutes.

Start.Label: Start it and register auto-start
Start.Hint: pm2 starts it again even after the server reboots.

Check.Label: Check that it works

Caddy.BridgeComment: Voice bridge (keep this block above the Foundry settings)
